findings.title: The Book resists imposed deformation
findings.claim: The Book's freedom from crookedness can be heard as resistance to being rendered into a fragmented or internally discordant text: reception may attempt to impose a changed state, while the Book's integrity remains the object praised here.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 18:1:9:1 bears the exact state-change facet of root_000248/B002. The wider fragmentation contact at 15:91 and the unchangeable-words contact at 18:27 make that state-change relation active; the written-text carrier at 18:1:7:2 then meets 15:91, 4:82, and 39:23, where fragmentation is opposed by textual coherence. Together these contacts change the negative clause from a static description into a reading of protected textual wholeness while retaining its ordinary sense.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the praise includes the Book's lack of curvature: the clause presents a text whose reception can be contested without making its praised integrity disappear.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains intact: Allah did not place crookedness in the Book. This does not claim that human readers cannot fragment, misread, or dispute it, and the target connection rows supply Arabic and relation notes without target morphology.

epistemic.reason: A trusted, focus-anchored publication supports the resistance claim; the additional written-whole route is an inference from connection nominations whose target morphology is not supplied.

findings.title: Crooked speech meets the Book's measure
findings.claim: The Book's freedom from crookedness can also be heard as an active criterion: abstract deviation becomes visible as bent speech and conduct, while the Book stands as the binding measure by which such claims are exposed and adjudicated.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 18:1:11:1 bears the abstract-deviation facet of root_001057/B002. Wider occurrences connect crookedness with obstructing God's path and describe the revealed Book as free of crookedness and joined to truth and measure. The Book carrier at 18:1:7:2 also meets the binding-judgment facet of root_001283/B003 through wider descriptions of a Book judging disputes and arriving with balance and justice. The two contacts explain one another: the deviation is the kind of distortion the Book can expose, and the Book's adjudicative force explains why the exposure matters.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the clause as more than an attribute attached to the Book: it gives the Book a public measuring function that makes distorted speech answerable.
findings.containment: The primary assertion remains that the Book contains no crookedness. This does not rank the cited passages or turn the global relation into a complete legal or theological system; their target morphology is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The focus-anchored publication is trusted and the direct connection rows independently repeat the crookedness, truth, measure, and adjudication contacts, but their target morphology remains unavailable.

Their contact makes the praise answer not only to an unbent Book but also to an authority that remains beyond alteration and depletion.
